change_summary: The chosen theme (dark, light or system) now stays applied after navigating between pages; previously every navigation reverted the page to light until the quick settings panel was opened.
Root cause: Blazor enhanced navigation rewrites the html element attributes from the server response, so data-theme disappears while the preference stays saved in localStorage.

The quick-settings script now reapplies the saved preferences after any link click and after browser back/forward, immediately and across the next few animation frames, so the chosen theme survives navigation.

The wide blue (light theme) or dark (dark theme) band at the top of a narrow window is gone: the sidebar no longer takes a full-screen minimum height on mobile, so it keeps only the brand-bar height and the page content follows it.
Desktop layout is unchanged: the sidebar keeps its 250 px width, sticky position and full viewport height on wide screens.
The sidebar transition now covers only text and border colors, so changing the theme during a session repaints the sidebar background immediately instead of keeping the previous theme color.
Only presentation changed; no money, data, permission or database semantics were touched.
review_findings: Build after the change: dotnet build Wizz.Presentation -c Release = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only).
Solution tests after the change: Domain 24/24; Integration 262/262 (286 total).

Browser check on the real instance at http://localhost:5183: after choosing dark, data-theme stayed dark and the body background stayed rgb(31, 31, 31) when sampling at 0, 50, 120, 300 and 700 ms after clicking links to /ai, /settings, /reports and /products, and after browser back; the quick settings panel was not opened during the check.

Theme switch check: switching from the panel changed the sidebar background immediately from rgb(30, 58, 95) to rgb(37, 37, 38) and back; the panel still opens, applies the theme and closes with Escape.

Narrow-layout measurement inside a 430 px wide frame: the sidebar is 67 px high instead of the full first screen (about 880 px), the content starts at 123 px, and there is no horizontal scrolling in either theme.
Wide layout remains 250 x 700 px, sticky at the top; no console errors were reported during the checks.

Limitation: the 286 automated tests do not cover navigation behavior, theme persistence or responsive layout; the evidence above is manual and was not reproduced in CI because GitHub Actions remains unavailable for the account.
Boundary note: the changes are presentation-only; money, stock and permission settings stay in the full settings page and were not altered.
Execution remains unauthorized outside the recorded limited scopes (D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32, D-33).
Phase 3 (cash drawer, purchases, UI, sync) is not implemented and not authorized.
MVP-AT-09 still requires a real restore test in a separate environment.
